{{Quote|Derrown, known simply as the Exterminator.|Count Dooku, introducing Derrown|<ref name="The Box">{{TCW|The Box}}</ref>}}
'''Derrown''' was a [[Parwan/Legends|Parwan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Derrown was ruthless and considered to be one of the best bounty hunters in the galaxy. As the Parwan's biology produced intense electrical fields, it earned him the title of the '''Exterminator'''. His Parwan physiology allowed him to reach various heights and vantage points not easily accessible to those of standard density, although he lacked the speed and control that came with such mass.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> During the [[21 BBY/Legends|second year]] of the war, Derrown was brought to [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]], along with other bounty hunters including [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] disguised as [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardeen]], and [[Embo/Legends|Embo]]. He, along with the other ten bounty hunters, would be put in the [[Box/Legends|Box]] to see who would take part in a plot to kidnap [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Does anyone know what this gasbag is saying?|Cad Bane|<ref name="The Box" />}}
In the first challenge of the [[Box/Legends|Box]], Derrown, as well as the other [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], survived the [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] gas, [[Dioxis/Legends|Dioxis]], thanks to the [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|disguised]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan's]] quick plan to escape. In the second challenge, a room filled with spinning [[Electrified laser blade/Legends|electrified laser blades]], Derrown was able to once again escape quickly by using his [[Parwan/Legends|Parwan]] abilities float to the hole in the roof, where he made his way out, following [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] and Obi-Wan Kenobi.<ref name="The Box" />

[[File:DerrownPassesThruShield-TB.png|thumb|left|220px|Derrown passes through the ray shield]]
In the third challenge, Derrown played a vital role to the survival of the other hunters. In this challenge, [[Ray shield/Legends|ray-shielded]] walls began to close in on the hunters, while a switch to deactivate it lay behind another ray shield. Derrown was able to inject himself with an electrified serum, provided by [[Moralo Eval/Legends|Moralo Eval]]&mdash;which would have been deadly to all the other hunters&mdash;to allow his electrified Parawan body to pass through the ray shield. Derrown did so with ease, and shut off the ray shields, allowing the surviving bounty hunters to pass into the final challenge.<ref name="The Box" />

After the disguised Obi-Wan Kenobi completed the fourth and final challenge, Derrown and the remaining hunters, including Kenobi, [[Twazzi/Legends|Twazzi]], [[Embo/Legends|Embo]], and Bane formed the group with the task to kidnap [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="The Box" />

[[File:Palpatine kidnapping team meeting.png|thumb|right|220px|Derrown and Dooku's team on Naboo.]]
Immediately upon arriving on Naboo, the hunters infiltrated a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]]; Derrown killed two mechanics, strangling one with his tentacles and snapping the neck of another. After securing the hangar, all the bounty hunters were given their instructions by Bane. Derrown was assigned to be disguised as a [[Senate Commando/Legends|Senate Commando]]; he would breach the ray shield that would be surrounding the chancellor and destroy the main generator, allowing the rest of the hunters to make off with the chancellor.<ref name="Crisis on Naboo">{{TCW|Crisis on Naboo}}</ref>

On the trail leading to the stage, Derrown was confronted by [[SG-1984/Legends|another Senate Commando]]. However, he managed to pass through. With nothing to stop him, Derrown sneaked beside the shield generator, deactivated it, and put it on self-destruct. The blast knocked Chancellor Palpatine unconscious and blew his cover. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] rushed to attack Derrown and the Parwan used his [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] to fire at Skywalker, only to have them sliced in two by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] [[Anakin Skywalker's second lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Derrown was then able to subdue Skywalker with ease by electrically shocking him with his tentacles. Derrown then attempted to escape using his [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]], but Obi-Wan Kenobi, still in disguise as Rako Hardeen, used a [[Sniper rifle/Legends|sniper rifle]] to disable the jetpack, sending Derrown spinning out of control and into the ground.<ref name="Crisis on Naboo" />

Later, Derrown was seen at [[Plop Dribble's/Legends|Plop Dribble's]] on [[Stobar/Legends|Stobar]]. He went hiding behind bar, when [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] choke a [[Sassi/Legends|women]].<ref name="Crisis on Naboo" />

Derrown was at [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's palace]] to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] when he saw [[Darth Maul/Legends|Maul]], [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]], and Opress confront [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] and [[Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo/Legends|Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo]], where both Hutts sumbit to Maul's rule.<ref name="Eminence">{{TCW|Eminence (episode)}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Derrown was a male Parwan who was considered one of the most ruthless and best bounty hunters in the galaxy during the Clone Wars.<ref name="The Box" /> He had [[Color/Legends|gray]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and brown skin.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Derrown's body was gas-filled body allowed him to float.<ref name="The Box" /> His tendrils were capable of delivering deadly electric shocks,<ref name="Crisis on Naboo" /> which led to him receiving the grim nickname the Exterminator.<ref name="The Box" />

==Skills and abilities==
Derrown was skilled in armed and unarmed combat. Derrown's Parwan physiology, coupled with his jetpack expertise, enabled him to excel at aerial maneuvers. Derrown's infiltration skills combined with his physiology also enabled him to play a key role as a member of the group of bounty hunters working for Cad Bane, as they broke into and seized control of a hangar in [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]. His skills in infiltration also enabled him to assist in disabling a [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield]] that protected the Supreme Chancellor during Bane's kidnapping attempt on Naboo.<ref name="Crisis on Naboo" />

==Equipment==
Derrown wore a jetpack that sported a [[shoulder-mounted blaster]] and wore special [[Bandolier/Legends|bandolier]] that insulate his [[Bioelectricity/Legends|bioelectricity]] from triggering the explosives and has holsters for his blasters. Derrown was armed with unique [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]] that squeeze the triggers with enough force to fire blaster bolts.<ref name="Concept Art>{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/the-box-concept-art-gallery|text="The Box" Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slide 3}}</ref> He used the [[Multispectrum disguise suite|holographic disguise matrix]] during the [[Festival of Light/Legends|Festival of Light]], posing as a Senate Commando.<ref name="Crisis on Naboo" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Revwien-MAAFGL.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Derrown was based off an [[Revwien/Legends|Revwien]] from Episode IV.]]
The character of Derrown was voiced by [[Matthew Wood]] in ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' TV series.<ref name="The Box" /> Derrown's design was based on a piece of artwork done by [[Ron Cobb]] of a colorful and odd [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] alien from the [[1977]] original ''[[Star Wars]]'' film [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] that ultimately went unused. Unlike Derrown, who is more like a sentient gasbag, Cobb's artwork described the alien as a ambulatory and tropical plant.<ref name="Trivia">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/the-box-trivia-gallery|text="The Box" Trivia Gallery}} {{C|Slide 3}}</ref>
